about: Client-side mappings from what the kinesics realizer says a body shows to that body's joints or bones. The bot does not know them: a client picks one per session. Each target is its rest value plus the sum of gain x source, in degrees. Sources (kinesics/mapping.js): head_away and eye_away (degrees away from the partner, unsigned), head_away_sided and eye_away_sided (the same, signed to the side the body looks away to), head_pitch (degrees, chin up positive), live_yaw and live_pitch (the small continuous motion, degrees), torso_lean (degrees, towards the partner positive), hand (0 = at rest, 1 = raised), blink (0 to 1), mouth (the resting mouth posture, 0 = closed, 1 = the usual opening while speaking), const (always 1). Every gain is chosen, not measured; kinesics-profiles.md, section 4, says why each has its value.

g1.about: Unitree G1: targets are MuJoCo joint names; positive waist_pitch leans forward. Rest is the stand pose with the arms of robot/turn-poses.json.

side.about: The look away is a waist turn to the side, at 40% of the head's and the eyes' angles. The human torso lean and the small continuous motion are not shown.

forward.about: The look away is a forward bend at the waist, so the chest keeps facing the partner: 40% of the head's and the eyes' angles, on top of the lean from the head's pitch.

vrm.about: A VRM avatar: targets are bone.axis of the normalized humanoid bones (the model faces +Z, +X is its left; chin up is a negative rotation about x), plus eyes.yaw, eyes.pitch (degrees, for the model's look-at), blink, and mouth (the model's open-mouth expression, 0 to 1: the resting posture, under the lip movement).

natural.about: Neck 40% and head 60% of each head angle; the small continuous motion at a quarter of its measured size; arms hanging, the right forearm raised by the hand.
